name: Pistole Magier
source:
Meguru is a university student who spends her days playing video games.

She was spending her day as usual when she came across a game online called "Pistole Magier." Suddenly, she was dragged into the game.

She was helped by a young man, Keln, who also got dragged into the video game. She found out that she apparently had to complete the game in order to return to her own world. Determined to win, they began to work together.

However, what stands in front of them is the invincible boss- a pair of twin boys who have exceeded the power level limit due to a bug that allows them to manipulate "magic" that didn't originally exist in the system.

[Translated from [url=https://blulunetta.web.fc2.com/pistole/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
Meguru是一名大学生，每天都在玩电子游戏。

当她像往常一样度过一天时，她偶然发现了一款​​名为“Pistole Magier”的在线游戏。突然，她被拉进了游戏。

她得到了一个名叫凯恩的年轻人的帮助，他也被卷入了电子游戏中。她发现自己显然必须完成游戏才能回到自己的世界。决心获胜，他们开始齐心协力。

然而，站在他们面前的却是无敌的boss——一对双胞胎男孩，由于一个bug让他们能够操纵系统中原本不存在的“魔法”，从而超出了力量等级限制。

[翻译自[url=https://blulunetta.web.fc2.com/pistole/story.html]官网[/url]]
